selection: Latest fully completed entry and natural exit produced by SHA-pinned independent ClosedMR40 engine on 8,514 frozen Bybit BTCUSDT Spot 4h candles; dates selected BEFORE reading 2026-10-14 trade print archive.

latency_cases.latency_justification: Measured official Bybit public SPOT native-confirmed 4h close received at 2026-10-22T20:00:00.8162316Z, 816.2316ms after the next 4h boundary. Ceil to first eligible integer-ms print at +817ms. Stress +1500ms. This observation is at a different date and may not characterize historical latencies.
latency_cases.assumed_execution_proxy: Only first actual public trade price at or after t, t+817 and t+1500ms in EXACT respective 4h bin. For long entry and sell exit, use same delay case at both. Do not use any trade print before each cutoff.
latency_cases.gross_markout_formula: For a hypothetical full 500USDT quote purchase at historical FIRST LAST-SALE print price, gross USDT markout=500*(exit_print_price/entry_print_price-1). No fees/spread/market liquidity/size or guaranteed order fill; not actual demo PNL.
latency_cases.comparison: Report price deltas at each leg vs first 4h print, signed long-roundtrip markout for each latency case, delta vs zero-latency first-print baseline, source trade timestamp delay in ms, exact raw archive sha256, source row counts. No cherry-pick/winner retuning.

file_validation.source_high_quality: Reject invalid trade prices/volumes, malformed CSV, missing target execution proxy prints, different price source/day

limitations: Archive trade prints are historical public market last sales. Their first available price after cutoff is NOT a fill quote, likely not actually obtainable for a new order, and latency of Oct22 session is not guaranteed on historical dates. This can assess optimistic assumptions of historical next-open fills, not performance proof or live execution capability.
